subject.title: fix(deepinfra): apply request policy to video generation requests

question: Should DeepInfra native video-generation requests honor the existing configured `models.providers.deepinfra.request.allowPrivateNetwork: true` opt-in, matching the shared provider HTTP policy, rather than always forcing private-network denial?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically narrow and proves both opt-in and fail-closed outcomes, but whether video traffic belongs inside that private-network permission is a security-policy choice that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Confirm request-policy parity
options.body: Accept configured request policy for DeepInfra video traffic while preserving the resolver’s default fail-closed behavior when the option is omitted or false.

options.title: Retain video-specific denial
options.body: Keep the forced private-network denial and document why DeepInfra video generation must be stricter than the other provider HTTP paths.

recommendation.title: Confirm request-policy parity
recommendation.body: Accept configured request policy for DeepInfra video traffic while preserving the resolver’s default fail-closed behavior when the option is omitted or false.
